title: 恐龙快打换成第一人称，会怎样？三种视角实战
description:
同一关分别用侧视、角色身后和第一人称打到关底，比较视野与战斗体验。

en.title: What If Cadillacs and Dinosaurs Were First Person? Three Views Tested
en.description:
Play the first stage in side view, rear view and first person, comparing visibility and combat all the way to the boss.
Edited development footage recorded on 2026-10-05. Features, controls and issues shown belong to that earlier build; the current demo may differ.
Chinese narration with reviewed English subtitles. The game interface is currently in Chinese; follow the current in-game control prompts.
Fan-made, unofficial Cadillacs and Dinosaurs remake. Original rights belong to Capcom and the original rights holders.
Current browser demo: https://www.zhengxiaohui.cn/html/game/cadillacs-stage1-3d/index.html
